scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/verify-phase2-production-bundle.mjs && node scripts/verify-phase2-worker-bundle.mjs && node scripts/verify-private-secret-bundle.mjs && node scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs
scripts.build:phase2-dev: tsc -b && node scripts/verify-phase2-dev-config.mjs && vite build --mode phase2-dev && node scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs --phase2-dev && node scripts/verify-phase2-dev-bundle.mjs && node scripts/verify-private-secret-bundle.mjs
scripts.build:phase2-kyc: tsc -b && vite build --mode phase2-kyc && node scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs && node scripts/verify-kyc-production-bundle.mjs && node scripts/verify-phase2-worker-bundle.mjs && node scripts/verify-private-secret-bundle.mjs
scripts.build:phase2-documents: tsc -b && vite build --mode phase2-documents && node scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs && node scripts/verify-property-documents-production-bundle.mjs && node scripts/verify-phase2-worker-bundle.mjs && node scripts/verify-private-secret-bundle.mjs
scripts.build:phase2-production: tsc -b && vite build --mode phase2-production && node scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs && node scripts/verify-phase2-full-production-bundle.mjs && node scripts/verify-phase2-worker-bundle.mjs && node scripts/verify-private-secret-bundle.mjs
scripts.build:phase2-agents: tsc -b && vite build --mode phase2-agents && node scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs && node scripts/verify-private-secret-bundle.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run lint && npm run test:run -- --maxWorkers=2 && npm run build:phase2-production && node scripts/confirm-deploy.mjs production && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:phase2-dev: npm run lint && npm run test:run -- --maxWorkers=2 && npm run build:phase2-dev && node scripts/confirm-deploy.mjs phase2-dev && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.phase2-dev.jsonc
